text:
jordan_finance: heads up - NovusCare invoice #9021 ($4,950) autopay declined (soft decline). Customer on support call, asking for options to avoid service interruption.
payments-bot: [AUTOPAY] invoice=9021 status=failed code=soft_decline attempts=1 next_retry=2026-04-01T14:00:00Z
liam_support: Do they have ACH linked? I see no bank account on file.
neha_billing: No, only the original card which failed at auth. Customer just said they can initiate bank transfer or try same-day ACH.
jordan_finance: Same-day ACH is possible but cutoff is 5pm ET for origination today. Time now ~2:30pm PT. If they can send by 4:30pm ET we'll get settlement EOD. Otherwise wire is safer for today.
liam_support: I'll ask customer which they prefer. Quick note: for same-day ACH we need routing + account type + depositor name; for wire we provide full bank instructions and require remittance screenshot.
neha_billing: Also: for ACH please give them this reference format so auto-match works: "INV9021-NOVUSCARE". If they paste something else reconciliation fails.
oli_payments: (system) reminder: bank holidays may delay settlement.
liam_support: Customer: "We can do same-day ACH, bank says they can initiate now. Sending details."
liam_support: sending guidance to customer: "Please send routing number, account number, account type (checking/savings), and the account holder name exactly as on the bank account. Use reference: INV9021-NOVUSCARE. We'll monitor for incoming ACH and apply immediately."
jordan_finance: If ACH doesn't arrive by cutoff, we will accept a wire. Provide wire template below — use internal only.
neha_billing: Wire template (internal):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Meridian Cloud Bank (US)
Routing/ABA: 222000111
Account: 123456789
SWIFT: MCBKUS44
Reference: INV9021-NOVUSCARE
Email confirmation to: settlements@redwood.com
```
neha_billing: For wires we require a screenshot of the bank confirmation showing FedRef or trace number. Apply payment to invoice and disable autopay token once posted.
liam_support: Customer replied with ACH details: routing=222000111, acct=4455667788, type=checking, name=Novus Care LLC. Initiated by bank just now.
jordan_finance: Good. I'll watch ledger for ACH trace. If it hits, notify neha_billing to apply. If not by cutoff, we'll ask customer to send wire and provide same-day escalation.
ops-oncall: FYI if ACH posts but reconciliation fails, escalate to ops-oncall with ACH trace id.
payments-bot: [TICKET] created FIN-4893: NovusCare invoice 9021 manual payment path (ACH initiated).
liam_support: Customer says bank confirms initiation and gave trace 9876543210. Will send screenshot.
neha_billing: Once screenshot received, I'll mark invoice processing and hold any service suspension.
jordan_finance: thanks team. closing when funds applied. :white_check_mark:
